evals.prompt: I just finished a learning session with my daughter. We did 3 math exercises on fractions, marked them and got 2 correct, 1 wrong. I taught her the wrong one (it was about adding unlike denominators). I also created a new knowledge page for this topic. Before I close this session, create a handoff document so I remember what we did and what to do next.
evals.expected_output: A session-handoff markdown file saved to .temp/ that captures: (1) summary of exercises completed and knowledge page created, (2) decision to create knowledge page, (3) mistake/lesson about the unlike denominators error, (4) any unfinished tasks, (5) next-step instructions

assertions.name: document_created
assertions.description: A handoff document was created and saved

assertions.name: has_summary
assertions.description: Document contains a Summary section describing what was accomplished

assertions.name: has_decisions
assertions.description: Document lists Decisions Made (teaching immediately, knowledge page creation, etc.)

assertions.name: has_mistakes_and_lessons
assertions.description: Document captures Mistakes & Lessons from the session

assertions.name: has_unfinished_tasks
assertions.description: Document lists Unfinished Tasks in a clear, actionable format

assertions.name: has_pickup_instructions
assertions.description: Document contains Pickup Instructions with files to open and next steps

assertions.name: mentions_learning_lab_context
assertions.description: Document acknowledges this is a learning-lab session (mentions Kejia, knowledge pages, mastery, etc.)

assertions.name: actionable
assertions.description: Instructions are specific enough to pick up work immediately (file paths, exact commands, section references)

evals.prompt: I've been refactoring a React component for 2 hours. I split a 400-line LoginForm into LoginForm, LoginInput, and LoginButton components. I ran the test suite and 3 tests failed (related to form submission). I fixed 2 of them but the third one (async state management in LoginButton) is still broken and I'm not sure why. I need to switch to another project now. Can you create a handoff document so I can pick this up later?
evals.expected_output: A session-handoff markdown file that includes: (1) summary of refactoring work, (2) decision to split into 3 components (and why), (3) mistakes/lessons about the async state management bug, (4) unfinished task (fix LoginButton async test), (5) pickup instructions with file paths and the specific test that's failing

assertions.name: document_created
assertions.description: A handoff document was created and saved

assertions.name: has_summary
assertions.description: Document contains a Summary section describing the refactoring work

assertions.name: has_decisions
assertions.description: Document explains why the 400-line component was split into 3 components

assertions.name: has_test_failures
assertions.description: Document clearly identifies which tests failed and which were fixed (2 fixed, 1 broken)

assertions.name: has_debugging_guidance
assertions.description: Document provides debugging strategy or root cause candidates for the async bug

assertions.name: has_unfinished_tasks
assertions.description: Document lists unfinished work (async state bug) as a clear next task

assertions.name: has_pickup_instructions
assertions.description: Document contains Pickup Instructions with file locations and test commands

assertions.name: actionable_debugging
assertions.description: Enough detail to resume debugging immediately (test file, failure symptom, next debugging step)

evals.prompt: Quick session check-in: I've been working on documentation for 30 minutes. I wrote an API reference for the `/users/:id` endpoint, added examples for GET and POST. I reviewed the existing docs and found 3 places where examples were outdated (`/products`, `/orders`, `/settings`). I updated products and orders but didn't have time for settings. I also realized the docs need a table of contents (not added yet). I'm getting close to running out of context. Give me a handoff doc.
evals.expected_output: A session-handoff markdown file with: (1) summary of documentation work, (2) decisions made (e.g., format chosen for examples), (3) lessons from finding outdated examples, (4) unfinished tasks (fix /settings docs, add TOC), (5) next steps and file locations

assertions.name: document_created
assertions.description: A handoff document was created and saved

assertions.name: has_summary
assertions.description: Document summarizes the API documentation work (users endpoint + reviews)

assertions.name: has_decisions
assertions.description: Document explains prioritization decisions (fixed examples before adding TOC)

assertions.name: has_mistakes_and_lessons
assertions.description: Document captures lessons (underestimated review time, should audit first)

assertions.name: has_unfinished_tasks
assertions.description: Document lists unfinished work: /settings examples, table of contents, testing

assertions.name: has_pickup_instructions
assertions.description: Document includes file paths and next steps with priorities

assertions.name: clear_priorities
assertions.description: Tasks are marked with priority levels (HIGH, MEDIUM, etc.)

assertions.name: context_aware
assertions.description: Document mentions context limit as the reason for stopping (awareness of constraints)
